name: Phishing Email Campaign
description: An employee received a phishing email impersonating the IT department. The email contains a malicious link that harvests credentials. You must identify the phishing attempt, investigate affected users, and respond appropriately.
objective: Identify the phishing email source, find affected users who clicked the link, and disable compromised accounts.

events.message: Suspicious email received: From: it-support@company-update.net Subject: 'Urgent: Password Reset Required' - contains credential harvesting link http://198.51.100.22/login
HTTP GET http://198.51.100.22/login from 10.0.2.55 - User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (user clicked phishing link)
Accepted credentials for jsmith from 198.51.100.22 - possible credential theft replay
Suspicious auto-forwarding rule created for jsmith@company.com -> attacker@evil.com

hints: Check the email server logs for messages from suspicious external domains
Look for users who clicked links in the suspicious email
After credential theft, attackers often set up email forwarding rules
Disable the compromised account immediately to prevent further damage
